tabId.description: Target Chrome tab ID (defaults to currently active tab if omitted)

method.description: Filter by HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.)

onlyErrors.description: Return only failed requests or HTTP status >= 400 (default: false)

limit.description: Maximum number of recent network requests to return (default: 100)

clearAfterRead.description: Clear the internal network buffer after reading (default: false)
